extensions/answer.ts.remark: diverged: local adds markdown rendering for question text and context (Markdown component + getMarkdownTheme). Upstream renders questions as plain wrapped text. Local extraction tries openai-codex/gpt-5.6-luna, then the extension-defined exe-dev-openai/gpt-5.6-luna@llm model; the exe.dev catalog ID is normalized to the gateway-native gpt-5.6-luna request ID. Local retries after request or JSON failures and reports all failures instead of falling back across upstream's Codex models, Haiku, and current model. Also: keybinding system (keyHint vs hardcoded), visual (editor theme, confirmation dialog style)

extensions/files.ts.remark: functionally_same through 13bc8f8: upstream's Ctrl+Shift+F removal was already present locally. Remaining intentional removals are 2 keyboard shortcuts, quick-diff, and findLatestFileReference; local also adds a defensive content guard and differs in editor config (zed vs code), keybindings, and visuals

extensions/prompt-editor.ts.remark: diverged: upstream fixes through 4fb0c7d are applied. Remaining intentional local differences are comma/period cycle shortcuts instead of Ctrl+Space, stronger typing/defensive guards, preservation of mode order and concurrent edits during persistence, support for max thinking effort, and code style.

extensions/session-breakdown.ts.remark: functionally_same through ab1e7f3: intentional local differences are the keybindings manager with keyHint-based close/cancel help, faux-provider filtering, visibleWidth/truncateToWidth correctness for ANSI and wide text, and formatting/style

extensions/goal.ts.remark: functionally_same: biome formatting (tabs to spaces, line wrapping), replaced non-null assertions with return values from setGoalStatus/setGoal to satisfy noNonNullAssertion lint rule. Local registerTool parameter tokenBudget uses TypeScript-style camelCase instead of upstream token_budget
